card.stopContainerConfirmDescription: {{name}} saves through RCON first, but the container itself is stopped by Docker -- if it doesn't exit in time, Docker force-kills it. This can end in an ungraceful termination, unlike the regular Stop button.
card.stopConfirmDescription: This will disconnect all connected players. You can start it again anytime.
card.switchAndStart: Switch to this server and start it
card.configureSftpTitle: Configure the SFTP bridge for this remote server
card.noPermissionDocker: Managing this container requires the docker.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.
card.noPermissionManage: This action requires the servers.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.
card.noPermissionStartStop: Requires both servers.manage and server.control — a partial permission set would leave the server activated but not started/stopped.

addDialog.descRemote: Connect to a PZ server on another machine via RCON. Only RCON-based features will be available.
addDialog.descLocal: Scan a folder to auto-detect server paths, or enter them manually
addDialog.rconOnlyDesc: Features like config editing, mod management, backups, server start/stop, and file operations will be unavailable. You can still use the console, manage players, send chat messages, control weather and events, and run scheduled commands.
addDialog.noPermission: Adding a server requires the servers.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.

remoteForm.hostHint: Address of the machine running PZ. Use 127.0.0.1 only when the panel and server share this machine.
remoteForm.rconPasswordPlaceholder: Enter the RCON password set in the server's INI file
remoteForm.gamePortHint: The PZ game port — used for display purposes only

localForm.autoDetectDesc: Scan a folder to find all PZ servers automatically
localForm.scanPathPlaceholder: Path to scan for PZ servers
localForm.noMatchingScript: ⚠ No matching startup script - will use default install path
localForm.noInstallPath: ⚠ No install path found - enter manually below
localForm.dataPathHint: The folder containing Server/, Saves/, Logs/ subfolders
localForm.installPathPlaceholder: Path to PZ server folder (contains StartServer64.bat or start-server.sh)
localForm.customLauncherNoticeBody: This path points at a script, not a folder — the panel will launch it as-is and will never regenerate or edit it. Settings that are normally written into a launch script for you (memory, admin password, the data path, the server name) will not reach the server unless you put them in this script yourself.
localForm.noConfigsFoundDesc: Run the server once to create the INI file.
localForm.rconPasswordRequired: Required for server control. You can also set <1>RCONPassword=yourpassword</1> in your {{iniName}}.ini file.
localForm.passwordWillImport: Imported automatically from {{iniName}}.ini — leave blank to use it, or type a new one to override.
localForm.discoverNoPermission: Detecting or scanning for servers requires the servers.discover permission, which this role doesn't have.

editDialog.lifecycleProviderHint: Direct starts the game server as a panel child process. systemd and OpenRC keep it in an independent operating-system service.
editDialog.lifecycleMigrationWarning: Managed services are opt-in. Download and install the generated service file first, stop every existing instance, then activate it. The panel never installs files in /etc or runs sudo.
editDialog.lifecycleConfirmDesc: Change this server from {{current}} to {{next}}? The backend will refuse if a process is running, the service is missing, or its ownership marker conflicts.
editDialog.lifecycleTemplateReadyDesc: Review the file and install it at {{path}} as an administrator.
editDialog.lifecycleTemplateFailed: Could not generate the service file
editDialog.lifecycleActivationFailed: Could not activate the lifecycle provider
editDialog.lifecycleCompleteFirst: Activate the selected lifecycle provider or switch back to the current provider before saving other server settings.
editDialog.title: Edit Server
editDialog.remoteDesc: RCON-only management is available for this server.
editDialog.dockerContainerHint: Requires PANEL_DOCKER_CONTROL_ENABLED and the container label zomboid-panel.managed=true.
editDialog.customLauncherNoticeBody: This path points at a script, not a folder — the panel will launch it as-is and will never regenerate or edit it. Settings that are normally written into a launch script for you (memory, admin password, the data path, the server name) will not reach the server unless you put them in this script yourself.
editDialog.customStartCommandTooltip: Override the default startup script with a custom command. Supports arguments. Leave empty and the panel will regenerate the default bat/sh startup script from these settings every time the server starts — this OVERWRITES that file, including any manual edits, though a changed file is backed up first.
editDialog.noSteamHint: Use the non-Steam dedicated-server mode on the next start.
editDialog.rconHostTooltip: Leave as 127.0.0.1 if the panel runs on the same machine as the game server
editDialog.rconHostHintRemote: Address of the machine running PZ. Use 127.0.0.1 only when the panel and server share this machine.
editDialog.rconHostHintLocal: Use 127.0.0.1 when the panel and server share this machine.
editDialog.adminPasswordTooltip: Server admin password passed as -adminpassword launch argument. Takes effect on next server start.
editDialog.noPermission: Saving server settings requires the servers.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.

deleteDialog.title: Remove Server from Panel?
deleteDialog.description: This will remove "{{name}}" from the panel management.
deleteDialog.alsoDeleteFilesDesc: This will permanently delete all files in:
deleteDialog.dataPathNestedWarningTitle: This will also delete the world save
deleteDialog.dataPathNestedWarningDesc: This server's Zomboid data folder is inside the install folder above, so there's no separate copy — deleting it destroys the world save too. The panel refuses this until you move the data path in Settings or back it up yourself:
deleteDialog.filesNotDeleted: Server files will NOT be deleted - you can add this server back later.
deleteDialog.noPermission: Removing a server requires the servers.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.
deleteDialog.deleteFilesNoPermission: Deleting server files requires the server.wipe permission, which this role doesn't have. Removing the panel record alone is still allowed.

steamDialog.verifyDesc: Check and repair game files using SteamCMD
steamDialog.updateDesc: Download the latest version using SteamCMD
steamDialog.clearFolderHint: Deletes everything in the install path so you can reinstall from scratch. Use this if SteamCMD updates keep failing (stuck or corrupted download state) instead of fixing it manually.
steamDialog.branchHintDefault: Select the Steam branch to download from
steamDialog.noPermission: Updating or verifying server files requires the server.install permission, which this role doesn't have.

clearInstallDialog.title: Clear Installation Folder?
clearInstallDialog.descriptionAfter: — including the game files, SteamCMD's download state, and any mods installed there. Use this to recover from a SteamCMD update that keeps failing (corrupted or stuck installation). You'll need to run Start Update again afterward to reinstall from scratch. This does not affect your save data.
clearInstallDialog.noPermission: Clearing the installation folder requires the server.wipe permission, which this role doesn't have.
